title: Group Fitness Class Passes: cancellation-window basis for a late-cancel fee, an in-window refund and a no-show
content:
## Scope
This document states the Group Fitness Class Passes basis for cancelling a booked class and for missing one without cancelling, across every tier of the product.

## Basis still in force
Cancelling a booked class within the tier's cancellation window, counted in hours before the class's scheduled start, forfeits the credit that booking spent and charges the tier's late-cancel fee. Cancelling with more advance notice than that window refunds the spent credit back to the pack at no charge. A member who books a class and neither attends nor cancels it is recorded as having missed it without notice. The evidentiary basis for whether a given cancellation falls inside or outside the window is the member's own stated notice, matched against the class's scheduled time as held on file with the front desk; that comparison — not any other record — is what places the cancellation inside or outside the window.

## Basis no longer in force
The original clause stating that a no-show charges the tier's flat no-show fee on top of the credit already spent is no longer in force as the complete handling basis for how much a no-show charges; a different basis, conditioned on whether the member holds an active corporate wellness enrollment at the time the no-show is logged, now governs the amount charged.

## Points of judgement
- Whether a cancellation is inside or outside the window turns entirely on the comparison between the member's stated notice and the class's scheduled start time on file — not on whether the member's credit balance can absorb the forfeiture, and not on any system-side estimate of notice.
- A member who cancels with notice exactly equal to the cancellation window boundary, or who misses the class entirely, is not covered by the in-window refund; the in-window refund applies only to cancellations with strictly more notice than the window requires.

superseded_clauses: Failing to attend without cancelling is a no-show and charges no_show_fee_usd on top of the credit already spent.
